categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Xiangfenghua Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery anode materials, focusing mainly on graphite anode materials. The company also explores new carbon materials including silicon-carbon anodes, hard carbon anodes, and graphene materials. Its products serve the power battery market for new energy vehicles, 3C consumer electronics, and industrial energy storage sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced graphite and carbon material technologies, including artificial and natural graphite production, silicon-carbon composite anodes via vapor deposition, and graphene-based conductive additives. It employs order-based production supplemented by planned manufacturing, with strict quality control and outsourced processing for some graphite production steps. The R&D center is equipped with advanced testing and characterization facilities, focusing on high energy density, low expansion, and long cycle life anode materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers and new energy vehicle companies such as LG Energy Solution, Guoxuan High-Tech, and BYD. The company targets downstream industries including new energy vehicles, 3C consumer electronics, and industrial energy storage. It is expanding internationally, supplying to global clients like Volkswagen, SK On, and Panasonic.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major sales in the South China, East China, and Central China regions. It has production bases in Fujian, Sichuan, Hainan, Shanghai, and Shenzhen. International market expansion efforts focus on Germany, South Korea, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiangfenghua operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, specializing in the production of anode materials which are key components supplied to battery manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high energy density, fast-charging, and low-temperature performance graphite anode materials, alongside development of silicon-carbon and hard carbon anodes. It invests in new production bases and R&D centers, collaborates with top universities, and pursues a '169' high-quality development strategy focusing on carbon core technologies, six major markets, and nine product categories. It also prioritizes internationalization and customer risk management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of graphite anode materials and other lithium battery materials. The company uses a direct sales model with order-based production, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control to customers either at delivery or usage depending on the sales mode.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of lithium-ion battery anode materials with recognized core technologies and a stable customer base including industry leaders. It faces intense competition due to industry overcapacity and price pressures but maintains competitive advantages through technology innovation and quality control.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.39 billion, a 17.67% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 49.55 million, down 40.23%. Despite revenue decline due to market price pressures and increased financial expenses, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D. Total assets were about RMB 4.44 billion with net assets of RMB 2.17 billion at year-end.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiangfenghua offers high-performance graphite anode materials characterized by high energy density, low expansion, long cycle life, and fast charging capabilities. Its products are recognized for stable quality and tailored solutions for power batteries, consumer electronics, and energy storage. The company differentiates itself through continuous technological innovation, comprehensive R&D capabilities, and strategic partnerships with leading battery manufacturers.
